End of Consent Calendar
9.
Public Hearings
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS EXTENDING URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 972 WHICH ESTABLISHED A MORATORIUM ON NEW WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITIES IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY AND PROHIBITING THE ISSUANCE OF BUILDING PERMITS, USE PERMITS, AND ANY OTHER LAND USE ENTITLEMENTS RELATED THERETO. (COUNCIL) PURSUANT TO SECTION 15061(B)(3) OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), THIS PROJECT IS EXEMPT FROM CEQA REVIEW.
review, consider, waive reading of, and adopt an urgency Ordinance, captioned: AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS EXTENDING URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 972 WHICH ESTABLISHED A MORATORIUM ON NEW WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITIES IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY AND PROHIBITING THE ISSUANCE OF BUILDING PERMITS, USE PERMITS, AND ANY OTHER LAND USE ENTITLEMENTS RELATED THERETO.
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and award of contract for Cerritos Park East millwork improvements, Project No. 12795, Bid No. 1152-13. (COUNCIL)
1. reject the bid received for Cerritos Park East millwork improvements, Project No. 12795, Bid No. 1152-13; and
2. Direct staff to re-evaluate the project scope and re-advertise for bids.
B.
Consideration and award of contract for Cerritos Park East parking lot rehabilitation; and construction of Artesia Boulevard bike lane improvement, Project No. 10199, Bid No. 1151-13. (COUNCIL)
1. award a contract for the Cerritos Park East parking lot rehabilitation; and construction of Artesia Boulevard bike lane improvements, Project No. 10199, Bid No. 1151-13 to all American Asphalt in the amount of $98,098 and reject all other bids; and
2. authorize staff to negotiate a change order to include necessary repairs to the Cerritos Swim and Fitness Center parking area in an amount not to exceed $33,000.
C.
Consideration and award of a professional services contract to perform citywide engineering and traffic survey. (COUNCIL)
award a professional services contract to Albert Grover & Associates in an amount not to exceed $28,675 to complete the engineering and traffic survey.
D.
Consideration and award of a sole source contract for updating and maintaining the Water Division's Supervisor Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system. (COUNCIL)
1. Make the findings that staff has satisfied the purposes of the bidding statute of the Cerritos Municipal Code, and that it is reasonable and necessary to sole source the SCADA System update in accordance with Section 3.20.060 of the City of Cerritos Municipal Code.
2. Allocate $309,965 from the FY 2012-2013 Water Production and Distribution Budget to complete Phases I & II of the project; and
3. Authorize the Mayor and/or the Senior Assistant City Manager to enter into a contract with HSQ Technology for updating and maintaining the Water Division's SCADA System.

Report on Pending Legislation.

Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
